html:
Qaboos bin Said was the sultan of Oman from 1970 until his death in 2020, the longest reigning ruler in the Arab world at the time. He built the modern state.

He took power in July 1970 by overthrowing his father, Said bin Taimur, with British help. Oman then had three schools and a few kilometres of paved road. Qaboos used oil money to build schools, hospitals and roads, and he won the Dhofar war by pardon as well as force.

Abroad he kept Oman neutral, talking to Iran and the West alike, and hosted the secret talks that led to the Iran nuclear deal. He had no children, and his cousin Haitham succeeded him.
sum: Qaboos bin Said was the sultan of Oman from 1970 until his death in 2020, the longest reigning ruler in the Arab world at the time. He built the modern state.
